lines.en: [I will create a new ‘Story’ that has never existed before.]
At my words, every constellation in the hall fell silent.
It wasn't because they were shocked.
Rather, they seemed not to understand what I meant.
The first to speak was the giant constellation sipping liquor beside Thor.
[I have no idea what you mean by this new ‘Story’ of yours.]
According to ‘Ways of Survival’, the ‘Dokkaebi King’ had said this long ago.
「There are no new Stories under the <Star Stream>. Every Story is merely a fabrication based on an old Story.」
That ancient maxim expressed the dokkaebis' humility, and was also a statement that had to be transcended.
As I hesitated over my answer, the impatient constellations spoke up first.
[Does that Story have a ‘swordmaster’?]
A swordmaster······.
At the unexpected question, I nodded and answered.
[It does.]
Some constellations sighed at my answer, while others' eyes lit up. Then another constellation asked.
[Is there a grand magician too?]
[There probably will be.]
[A reincarnator?]
[There will be.]
[An SSS-grade hunter? For the record, I like someone who earns rewards through honest effort.]
[There might be. Though I don't like effort.]
[Of course there'll be a returnee too, won't there?]
Perhaps they were enjoying themselves; the varied questions continued for a while.
Some smiled along the way, while others shook their heads. But whatever their expressions, they were all imagining one story.
A story that had yet to be made.
But a story that might, perhaps, come to exist.
Was it because it had been so long since everyone in the Gourmet Association had plunged into such ‘imaginings’?
For a while, an atmosphere of warmth, unusual for the Gourmet Association, filled the hall.
But that atmosphere didn't last.
[I don't understand. Aren't there already plenty of stories like that?]
The one who threw cold water on it was the ‘Morning Star Goddess’, who had been listening all along.
[Swordmasters, grand magicians, reincarnators, returnees······ Why make another story like that? I simply cannot understand what could be ‘new’ about such a mass-produced product.]
I thought for a moment before answering.
[New subject matter isn't the only thing that makes a new Story. Aren't the ‘first-generation Stories’ the Gourmet Association loves also made up of ordinary material?]
[Are you comparing those ‘first-generation’ works of art to your Story?]
[I have no intention of comparing them. I'm not trying to make art in the first place.]
Disappointment flickered across some of the constellations' faces at my words.
The ‘Morning Star Goddess’ laughed as though I were ridiculous.
[You speak so crudely without a second thought. Very well. Then what is new about your story?]
The mood among the constellations was changing again.
As expected, I would have to make my move now.
Meeting their eyes one by one, I declared in a quiet True Voice.
[The Story I create will contain ‘the end of all scenarios’.]
The end of all scenarios.
For an instant, the air went still, as though it had frozen.
[H-how dare you······.]
Someone muttered, and some constellations went pale.
A sense of opposition that hadn't arisen even when I mentioned the ‘first generation’ was spreading through the entire audience.
Probably because I had violated their taboo.
Feeling their gazes pour down on me, I closed my eyes.
This wouldn't change the situation dramatically.
But my story would leave a deep impression in the constellations' minds.
For now, that was enough.
[······So you're a lunatic.]
Still, it seemed I had driven that impression in a little too deep.
A voice thick with hostility continued.
[I knew the Gourmet Association attracted all sorts of lunatics, but this one really takes the cake. Are you saying that shit in your right mind?]
A green humanoid figure (人形) with a dragon's head.
He was the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’.
A constellation who had acted as an [evil spirit] in the previous scenario.
His lips curled in a sneer as he continued questioning me.
[So what do you want us to help with? Are you saying some shit like, let's go to the end of those ‘scenarios’ together?]
[That's right. I came here to find constellations who will reach the end of the scenarios with me.]
The constellations' expressions changed at my calm declaration.
Some of them already belonged to ‘nebulas’.
So what I had just said would sound decidedly provocative.
[A nebula? What's your nebula called?]
[It doesn't have a name yet. We haven't formally founded it.]
[Hmm······ How many founding members are there?]
[Two.]
More constellations began to sneer.
I was a little offended, but I held it in.
Apparently, this was the Gourmet Association's idea of ‘courtesy’.
I had no intention of accepting bastards like them anyway.
The ‘Morning Star Goddess’ asked.
[One must be you. Who is the other? Are they a constellation too?]
[They aren't a constellation, but······.]
I hesitated over whether to reveal Yoo Joonghyuk now.
The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ spoke.
[Could it be that fellow?]
A video was playing on the panel onstage.
It was the final of the martial arts tournament underway in the <First Murim>.
―At last, the showdown you've all been waiting for!
At the announcer's words, the camera focused on a man.
―The disciple of Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, Supreme King Yoo Joonghyuk!
As expected, Yoo Joonghyuk seemed to have made it safely to the final.
Then his opponent was······?
―One of Murim's ten greatest masters, Ice Flower Goddess Zhuge Lingling (諸葛靈鈴)!
Entering beneath the dazzling spotlights, Zhuge Lingling wore a light, loose T-shirt and jeans.
The Ice Flower Goddess was by no means an easy opponent.
She was one of the ‘transcendents’ who would represent the next generation of Murim. Normally, she was a master far beyond the current Yoo Joonghyuk's ability to face.
The key was how much progress he'd made with his ‘Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship’ in the meantime······.
Someone's low grunt snapped me back to my senses.
I looked around.
And slowly, anger welled up.
······Damn it. So this was why they had put that video up.
I glared at Anna Croft, who stood in a corner of the stage with a vacant expression.
But judging by her expression, it didn't seem to be her doing.
Then the one who had put that video up was······.
[Heh heh······ A little talent show by mortals······.]
The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ laughed.
[Well, this is a letdown. A brat who only just reached Narrative-grade and one insignificant mortal were discussing ‘the end of the story’?]
Some constellations burst into laughter as though they'd been waiting for this.
It was laughter that dismissed everything I had said so far.
I had anticipated that things might turn out this way.
Perhaps expecting anything from the constellations had been a mistake in the first place.
[Hahaha! What was that constellation's modifier again? Was it ‘Demon King of Hot Air’?]
[Queen of the Underworld! You've brought us quite an entertaining fellow!]
Onscreen, Yoo Joonghyuk was facing the Ice Flower Goddess.
The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ snickered as though the sight were adorable.
[From what I can see, forget ‘the end of the scenarios’. Even the scenario he's in now looks like a struggle.]
I silently clenched my fist.
I knew every path Yoo Joonghyuk would walk and every feat he would accomplish.
I also knew perfectly well that the man who had kept striving and striving would one day slaughter every last member of this fucking ‘Gourmet Association’.
But in the eyes of the constellations here, the current Yoo Joonghyuk was merely another ‘insignificant mortal’.
[Perfect timing. I was getting bored now that the scenario's over. How about a bet, everyone? On which of those two insects will win.]
[Oh, excellent, excellent!]
Many constellations agreed with the proposal made by the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’.
Then a system message sounded.
[A new ‘sub-scenario’ has arrived.]
[Sub-scenario ― ‘Gourmet Association Betting’ will begin.]
Countless selection windows appeared before the constellations.
[I'll bet 50,000 coins on that female.]
As the Brash Swamp Predator shouted boldly, the other constellations guffawed and began placing bets one by one. The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ looked at me.
[Newbie. You place a bet too.]
[I already have.]
[On whom, and how much?]
[100,000 coins. On Yoo Joonghyuk.]
The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ glared at me for betting twice as much as he had.
[An insolent brat. You'll regret this.]
A look as though he knew how this wager would end.
From a distance, Anna Croft was watching me with quiet eyes.
Onscreen, Yoo Joonghyuk's desperate battle had already reached its midpoint.
[Oh, they're rather good. At that level, I'd like to take them as my incarnations myself.]
Yoo Joonghyuk had seemed to be losing ground at first, but as time passed, he was gaining the upper hand.
Some constellations voiced their admiration at his unexpected prowess. But the murderous aura rising from the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ quickly silenced them.
That's Yoo Joonghyuk for you.
Thanks to meeting the ‘Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’ ahead of schedule, his [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] far surpassed its original level.
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

Sky-breaking energy exploded in the arena, and the battered Ice Flower Goddess tumbled through the dust, coughing up blood. The tide had turned completely. As the story took an unexpected course, the expression of the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ also changed.
[······Hmm, it won't be any fun if we leave it at this.]

As a sense of foreboding came over me, sparks flew from several Gourmet Association constellations, including the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’. I realized what they were doing. Their sparks were spreading into the martial arts tournament onscreen.
More precisely, toward the ‘Ice Flower Goddess’.
―Aaaaaaagh!
As the ‘Ice Flower Goddess’ suddenly began screaming, the announcer spoke again.
―W-what in the world is this!
Yoo Joonghyuk seemed just as startled. His expression was hardening at the sight of the Ice Flower Goddess mutating into a monster.
Bzzzzzt!
I looked at the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ and spoke in an icy voice.
[Didn't you say this was a bet?]
The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ gave a strange laugh.
[I never said we wouldn't interfere.]
Bzzzzzt!
With the probability supplied by numerous constellations, green scales were covering the Ice Flower Goddess's body.
Both Yoo Joonghyuk and I knew what that meant.
A constellation's ‘descent’.
It had happened in [Peace Land], and in the [Dark Castle] too.
But back then, Yoo Joonghyuk and I had fought together. Now we weren't.
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’.]
[Connection to the target is currently impossible.]
······You damn bastard. What are you doing at a time like this?
Since Yoo Joonghyuk wasn't thinking about me at all, I couldn't even activate [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint].
Beyond the screen, a monstrous green dragon, halfway descended into the Ice Flower Goddess, roared.
The Brash Swamp Predator.
A primordial god of the planet ‘Selegedon’, he was a constellation whose Status, like mine, was at the lower end of Narrative-grade.
But the number of Stories he had accumulated was on an entirely different scale from mine, so his capabilities were far greater.
―BOOOOOOM!
A single breath from the Predator partly demolished a section of the tournament grounds.
He had probably completed a sponsorship contract with the Ice Flower Goddess in that brief interval.

His low synchronization with the incarnation body would prevent him from unleashing his full power, but having descended with that much probability support, destroying the tournament would be nothing to him.
Even the current Yoo Joonghyuk would have difficulty facing a Narrative-grade constellation with that many Stories.
[You look anxious. Don't you trust your companion?]
I turned to find Persephone smiling as she always did.
Didn't I trust him?
She needn't even ask.
There was no way I could trust that sunfish who died at the drop of a hat······.
[I do.]
And yet, why did that answer come out so readily?
At my effortless answer, a curious light flickered in Persephone's eyes.
[Trusting him is what brought me this far in the first place.]
I looked back at Yoo Joonghyuk onscreen.
Even after defeat, after being broken, after despairing time and time again.
The man who still wouldn't give up, right to the end.
If I didn't trust him, who could I trust?
Even if this round ended in failure······.
One day, he would surely see this world's ending.
Slowly closing my eyes and opening them again, I spoke.
[Let's raise the stakes. I'll bet 1,000,000 coins.]
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, has bet 1,000,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]

The system message echoing through the hall drew every constellation's attention. Betting money on a fight in which we were clearly at a disadvantage. Apparently, my action had piqued some constellations' interest.
[The constellation, ‘Thursday's Thunder’, regards you favorably.]
[The constellation, ‘Morning Star Goddess’, regards you favorably.]
But only a tiny minority of constellations reacted that way.
Most were simply swept up in the fever of the heated gambling.
[Hahaha! You're insane! Then I'll bet 500,000 coins too!]

The ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, who had sided with the Ice Flower Goddess from the start, fired the opening shot. Then the other constellations who had merely watched until then began joining in one by one.
[The constellation, ‘Tranquil Island Gourmet’, has bet 20,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Zhuge Lingling’.]
[The constellation, ‘Master of the White Castle’, has bet 30,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Zhuge Lingling’.]
The messages poured in one after another.
Most were bets on Ice Flower Goddess Zhuge Lingling.
I was the only one who had bet on Yoo Joonghyuk.
[The constellation, ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’, has bet 300,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
I instinctively turned to Persephone, who still wore that inscrutable smile. I asked in a slightly worried voice.
[······Are you sure about this?]
[Hmm? Sure about what?]
Her question left me at a loss for words.
Well, for someone like Persephone, betting 300,000 coins might be nothing.
But someone else intervened on my behalf.
[Ahem, old hag. Doesn't Hades nag you when you throw your secret stash around like that?]
[I'm not an old woman, so mind your words, ‘Mass Production Maker’.]
[Ahem, with that many damned years under your belt, of course you're an old hag······.]
[Watch your mouth unless you want to be thrown into Tartarus······ Wait. Don't tell me you placed a bet too?]
At Persephone's question, the ‘Mass Production Maker’ grinned.
[The constellation, ‘Mass Production Maker’, has bet 150,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ looked at me and spoke.
[This month's ‘Dokkaebi Bag’ payout wasn't very good, so I couldn't bet much.]
In fact, he had bet exactly the price of the [Eoren's Sword] I had bought.
That was probably how much net profit he had left after the fees.
Anyway, I was simply grateful that he had bet anything on our side, however little.
Thanks to that, the even more excited constellations were placing bets wildly.
[The constellation, ‘Goddess of Joy and Celebration’, has bet 50,000 coins on the incarnation ‘Zhuge Lingling’.]
The coins wagered snowballed until the pool had passed 6,000,000 coins. By then, no constellation in the ‘Gourmet Association’ could help losing their head.
[Kill him! Hurry up and kill him!]
[Lose my coins and I'll kill you!]
They were no different from humans at a fighting arena······.
It almost seemed strange that, after living through so many ‘stories’, they could still get excited over something like this.
As though reading my mind, the ‘Mass Production Maker’ laughed.
[Having lived through so many ‘stories’ only makes them hungrier for ‘stories’ like this.]
[······Perhaps you're right.]
[Human or constellation, we're all children before a story. But do you have a chance of winning?]
[Are you getting nervous?]
[Ahem, no, that's not what I······.]
[If there isn't a chance, we'll have to make one.]
To be precise, this was as good as fighting with our backs to the river.
If Yoo Joonghyuk died here, this round would be ruined.
If things were heading that way anyway, it would be better to settle this properly.
[Activating the exclusive skill, ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’!]
We would not lose.
[Connection to the target is currently impossible.]
Oh, Yoo Joonghyuk······ So you're still going to be like that.
But this wasn't the only way.
“Biyoo.”
[Baat.]
As though she'd been waiting, Biyoo moved her hands and brought up a personal panel before my eyes.
A screen appeared immediately afterward.
―Krrrrrrrrraaa!
Letting out a bizarre cry, the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ opened his enormous maw and spewed a dreadful poisonous mist (毒霧).
―Aaaaaaagh!
The Murim fighters touched by the spreading smoke screamed as their entire bodies burned away.

Judging by his descended state, the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ seemed to be using somewhat more than a third of his ‘Status’. Calling it a third made it sound small, but it was more than enough to lay waste to the tournament grounds.
The probability supplied by the surrounding constellations also played a large part.
Rrrrrrrumble!
The monstrous dragon's kicks tore up all the ground in the arena. The destructive force was immense. But it wasn't as great as in [Peace Land] or the [Dark Castle].
Back then, an actual ‘Outer God’ had descended.
Still, I couldn't guarantee that the situation was any better than in [Peace Land] or the [Dark Castle].
In [Peace Land], we'd had Kyrgios, ‘The Paradox Baekchung’.
In the [Dark Castle], we'd had Cheok Jungyeong, ‘Goryeo’s First Sword’.
······Who did we have now?
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, looks at the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
At my message, Yoo Joonghyuk frowned as though annoyed.
“······Kim Dokja. Are you finished?”
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, says he is still working on it.]
“Still?”
For an instant, a shadow of suspicion flickered in Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes.
Glaring at the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, Yoo Joonghyuk asked.
“Could it be······ that thing showed up because of you?”
Sharp bastard.
“······Kim Dokja!”
His fury was truly tremendous.
I extended a hand in apology.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, has donated 100 coins to the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’.]
“I don't need them!”
BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!
Then the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ moved.
A primordial lizard that ruled over every wetland on the planet. From its back protruded the head of the being who had once been the Ice Flower Goddess.
―Aaaaaaaaah!
The terrible scream of an incarnation whose body had been stolen. With that scream as its prelude, the lizard charged forward and swung its enormous tail at Yoo Joonghyuk.
Bzzzzt!
A mere brush from the lizard's tail dealt a heavy blow to the Strong Self-Defense surrounding Yoo Joonghyuk's body.
Yoo Joonghyuk seemed not to have reached stage 2 of Transcendent Form yet. Well, even for him, raising his Transcendent Form by a stage in just two weeks would have been too much.
Driving the Ice Flower Goddess into a corner like that at stage 1 alone showed a demonic level of talent.
Then we didn't have much time.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, requests possession.]
Yoo Joonghyuk had already experienced ‘Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint’ several times, so that alone should tell him what I meant.
But his response was unexpected.
“No.”
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, says everyone will die at this rate.]
“I won't die.”
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, says this is no time to be stubborn.]

Even if I descended into Yoo Joonghyuk and used [Electrification], I wasn't certain I could defeat that monster. There was also the option of using the [Fourth Wall] like last time, but that only worked against constellations using mental skills.
Rooooooar!

As Yoo Joonghyuk dodged the attacks with swift footwork, the enraged ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ prepared another poisonous mist. Judging by the intensity of the sparks bursting around his mouth, a truly tremendous attack seemed about to come crashing down.
I pressed Yoo Joonghyuk, but he wouldn't budge.
“Go do what you need to do, Kim Dokja.”
This unexpected turn left me flustered.
Seriously, why was this bastard being so stubborn today?
I hurriedly looked around.
At this point, I had no choice but to seek someone else's help, even if it ruined the tournament.
And there was only one person here powerful enough to help us.
Breaking the Sky Sword Saint Namgung Minyoung.
Her abilities rivaled Kyrgios's and Cheok Jungyeong's, so she should be more than capable of facing that monster. Before long, I found the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint eating dumplings in the stands.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’, requests help.]
But despite my message, the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint only kept diligently chewing her dumplings.
Occasionally, she also put a dumpling in the mouth of the Breaking the Sky Sword Master, sitting beside her with legs tucked together.
And in the seats directly below them, Jang Hayoung and Han Myungoh sat side by side, stuffing their faces with dumplings.
······Seriously, what the hell were these people doing?
Growing frantic, I sent another message.
[The constellation, ‘Demon King of Salvation’······.]
That was when Yoo Joonghyuk reacted.
“······Shin Yoosung. Are you listening?”
At those words, Biyoo appeared.
“Turn off Kim Dokja's screen.”
Biyoo looked at Yoo Joonghyuk as though she were in a bind.
I didn't know how much remained of Shin Yoosung's memories, but thinking about it, these two had quite a complicated relationship.
But that was all before her reincarnation. Things were different now.
Biyoo was my dokkaebi now, so she had no reason to listen to that bastard Yoo Joonghyuk.
But suddenly, Biyoo, perched on my shoulder, looked at me apologetically.
[Baat, baaat······.]
With a ludicrous bit of acting, Biyoo pretended to drift off to sleep.
At the same time, the personal panel went dark and Yoo Joonghyuk disappeared.
[Connection lost.]
“Wait, what is this······?”
I couldn't understand what on earth was going on.
Why was Biyoo suddenly doing this?
Even the revised ‘Ways of Survival’ hadn't mentioned a situation like this?
―Woooooooah!
At the sudden eruption of cheers, I turned toward the panel installed by the stage.
[What is that······?]
The startled constellations were rising into the air and approaching the panel one by one.
Persephone and the ‘Mass Production Maker’ had already moved right up to it. With over a hundred constellations crowding before the panel at once, the screen was completely obscured.
[Wait, hold on! Move aside a little!]
I tried to squeeze through a gap, but the constellations were packed too tightly.
All I could hear was the crash of thunder striking as the screen flashed.
KRRRROOOM!
But the sound alone was enough to tell me.
Breaking the Sky Sword Thunder (破天劍雷).
It was the sword's true thunderstrike, on an entirely different level from the one I had stolen and used.
―Gyaaaaaagh!
I heard the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ scream, as though he had suffered a tremendous blow.
With martial arts of that caliber, the answer was obvious even without seeing it.
Thank goodness the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint had stepped in.
At last, I managed a sigh of relief.
Now that the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint had intervened, Yoo Joonghyuk would be safe.
The tournament would fall through as a result······ but that was a hundred, a thousand times better than Yoo Joonghyuk dying.
But at that moment, someone shouted.
―Oh, the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint's disciple!
―It's the Breaking the Sky Sword Beauty (破天劍嬉)!
······Breaking the Sky Sword Beauty?
[I shouldn't have dismissed it as an incarnation's martial arts.]
[Hah, how could such a thing······ With merely a transcendent's power······?]
[Hahaha, what an interesting ability. Could that fellow from <Asgard> have done this?]
[It's not to my taste.]
True Voices I couldn't make sense of were heating up the hall.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, is aghast.]
[A constellation who enjoys changing genders is writhing with delight.]
[The constellation, ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’, sheds tears of indignation.]
In the channel, and in the banquet hall.
The flood of messages was making me dizzy.
[My coins! No! My coins······!]
[Aaaaaaaaah!]
Seriously, what on earth was happening that······.
I took a deep breath, even activated my ‘Status’, and pushed my way through the constellations. Just as I finally reached the front of the panel, another tremendous thunderstrike descended onscreen.
KRRRROOOM!
The powerful lightning turned the entire screen white.
The light slowly faded, and where it vanished, charred gray powder drifted like snow.
Beneath that falling snow, a man stood aloof.
It was Yoo Joonghyuk, holding his sword aloft with an arrogant expression.

An enormous lizard, burned black by the lightning, lay limp beneath his feet. Stepping on the lizard's corpse, Yoo Joonghyuk approached a corner of the arena and, without anyone's permission, pulled out the black saber planted there.
―There is no second place in this tournament.
It was the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword].
―So this is mine.
Belatedly, the announcer's voice rang out.
―The winner of the martial arts tournament has been decided!
I had no idea how such a thing had been possible.
Even on a second, closer look, the situation was unmistakable.
It wasn't the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint······ Yoo Joonghyuk had defeated it?
―The winner is Breaking the Sky Sword Beauty Yoo Joonghyuk!
Seriously, what the hell was this Breaking the Sky Sword Beauty······?
My questions didn't last long.
Because system messages began pouring into my ears.
[Sub-scenario― ‘Gourmet Association Betting’ has been completed.]
[You have won the bet.]
[You have acquired a new Story!]
[You have acquired the Story, ‘Miracle Gambler’.]
And somewhere, I heard what sounded like coins falling.
[You have received the sub-scenario reward.]
I instinctively checked my coin balance.
The numbers creaked upward, as though struggling to bear their own magnitude.
[Coins Held : 1,986,725 C]
[Coins Held : 2,790,876 C]
[Coins Held : 3,890,875 C]
The easy money the constellations had wagered was piling onto my balance like a blizzard.
[Coins Held : 5,490,875 C]
The endlessly climbing coin total finally stopped when it reached its peak.
That unbelievable number made me wonder again and again whether my eyes were deceiving me.
[······Young man, how much did you make?]
I turned to find the ‘Mass Production Maker’ looking dazed.
This old man had also bet 150,000 coins earlier, so he must have earned a considerable sum. My own payout alone was at least fivefold······.
[The constellation, ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’, envies you!]
[The constellation, ‘Loan Shark Aiming for the Heart’, covets your coins!]
Even Persephone's mouth was twitching at the corners, though she always wore such an aloof expression.
For the record, the Queen of the Underworld had bet 300,000 coins.
······The Underworld must have made quite a killing too.
[Impossible! This is impossible!]
Aside from the three of us, most of the constellations looked utterly devastated.
Their expressions alone were enough to tell me how much they had bet.
Those who had wagered small sums to pass the time merely looked disappointed, but the constellations who had bet 100,000 coins or more······.
[Aaaaaaaah!]
They were losing their minds with rage.
Some even seemed to have bet enough to bankrupt themselves.
That bastard, for instance.
[The constellation, ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, displays tremendous hostility toward you.]
Rrrrrumble!
[Grab him!]

The constellations who had lost their coins, including the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, were approaching me. Perhaps they'd lost their reason along with their coins; they looked ready to throw me into the Han River right then and there.
The constellations who had been watching the situation moved away from me. But one constellation didn't retreat.
The Queen of the Underworld, Persephone.
[Everyone, stand back. How much more disgraceful do you intend to become?]
As her ‘Status’, reminiscent of cold night air, resonated, the approaching constellations hesitated. But some were too worked up for a mere night breeze to cool them.
[Queen of the Underworld! Are you acting like this because you won a few coins?]
[We have no business with you, so move aside!]
As tempers rose, the high-ranking constellations who had been watching also intervened.
[Everyone, mind your manners.]
It was the ‘Morning Star Goddess’, who was on friendly terms with Persephone.
But the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, already out of his fucking mind, didn't hesitate.
[······Manners? Manners, my ass······!]

As the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, now right in front of me, released his ‘Status’, the other constellations unleashed theirs at the same time. Just as powerful sparks burst into the air, heralding a collision of ‘Status’.
[The wish right used by the constellation ‘Demon King of Salvation’ takes effect.]
Bzzzzzt!
Dazzling sparks covered the entire hall, and the agitated constellations stopped moving for an instant. As everyone hesitated, a portal opened in the ceiling.
An ominous aura surged beyond the portal.
It wasn't an ‘Outer God’.
But clearly, there was certainly something there every bit as tremendous.
Who was it? At this level, it had to be a constellation of the highest rank, or······.
Rrrrrumble······.
With an explosion that seemed to tear the air apart, an unfamiliar being emerged through the portal.
A being wrapped from head to toe in an utterly mysterious aura.
Yet that being was neither a god nor a constellation.
A man who appeared in black clothes like a magician's, leaning on an antique staff.
[······A Great Dokkaebi?]
It was a Great Dokkaebi.
[It has been a long time, constellations.]
With that single sentence, the hall fell silent as though doused in cold water.
It was an enforced silence. The constellations releasing their Status and those shouting all held their breath.
[The rules of the <Star Stream> bind every constellation in the ‘Gourmet Association’.]
Bzzzzzt!
Enough probability to bind every constellation present.
Even with the authority to operate a channel, an ordinary dokkaebi could never have done this.
Even the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’, who hadn't yielded to the threats of high-ranking constellations, was backing away, his face drained white.
I had read a description of that dokkaebi in the original novel.
「Most incarnations believe there are only four dokkaebi ranks. Low, intermediate, quasi-high, and high. But there are dokkaebis above them as well.」
「The leaders (首座) of the dokkaebis, bearing horns in twelve colors, who command the dokkaebis of the <Star Stream>.」
Seven red horns protruded from the dokkaebi's head.
The <Star Stream> called them ‘Great Dokkaebis’.
[My apologies, but the party ends here.]
Back when I was engrossed in ‘Ways of Survival’, I had once wondered about the relationship between constellations and dokkaebis.

However special the dokkaebis' powers might be, a high-ranking constellation could kill one or two of them without any trouble. Yet even constellations with that much power didn't casually lay hands on ‘dokkaebis’. No matter how irritating a scenario the dokkaebis opened, the constellations never killed them.
The reason was right before my eyes.
Bzzzzzz!
With a single gesture, a net of probability spread out and ensnared the entire ‘Gourmet Association’. Sparks of a density I had never seen before.
This, too, was the power of a ‘Story’.
A ‘Story’ probably borrowed from the most powerful being in this world.
Narrative-grade or Historical-grade, anyone who tried to leave would surely be swept up in that storm of sparks and annihilated.
Even high-ranking constellations such as ‘Thursday's Thunder’ and the ‘Morning Star Goddess’ merely looked deeply displeased, without voicing any complaint.
Persephone was the first to speak.
[Great Dokkaebi ‘Halong’. It has been a long time.]
The Great Dokkaebi slowly turned toward us.
[It has indeed, Queen of the Underworld.]
[Is the ‘King of Stories’ well?]
[His Majesty is in good health.]
Perhaps it was because of who she was dealing with; a tension I had never seen before lingered in Persephone's expression.
[What brings you here? And with the dokkaebis of the Enforcement Division, no less······.]

The dokkaebis of the [Enforcement Division] I had seen before were forming ranks behind the Great Dokkaebi. The terrifying presence they radiated rivaled that of the constellations in the ‘Gourmet Association’. That was only natural.
The dokkaebis of the Enforcement Division had once been ‘constellations’ themselves.
Instead of answering Persephone immediately, the Great Dokkaebi surveyed the constellations with quiet eyes.
[I must escort away the esteemed constellations who have taken out ‘coin’ loans.]
At that moment, several constellations groaned and began fleeing.
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ muttered as though he understood.
[What utter fools······.]
Apparently, some constellations had borrowed coins from the dokkaebis to join this gambling session.
Funnily enough, the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ was among them.
[Urrrgh······ Move, move aside!]
He charged at the sparking wall to tear through the net of probability the Great Dokkaebi had spread.
Bzzzzzt!
[Gaaaaaagh!]

The Great Dokkaebi's net was powerful. The moment his hand touched the net of sparks, the ‘Brash Swamp Predator’ screamed and went sprawling. The Enforcement Division's dokkaebis rushed over and easily restrained his incarnation body.
[Let go! Let me go!]
Watching the constellations being marched away in a line, I wondered why the dokkaebis had appeared here at this precise moment.
I didn't know the exact reason, but I suspected the probability of my ‘wish right’ might have influenced it.
Dokkaebis were the species most sensitive to ‘probability’ in this world, after all.
Having restrained all the debtor constellations (債務座) in an instant, the Great Dokkaebi began transporting them through the portal.
He moved swiftly, as though he had no further business here.
Without even saying farewell, the Great Dokkaebi merely gave several constellations a warning glare before leaving.
But in the final moment before the portal closed, the Great Dokkaebi looked at me.
Beyond those cold eyes, someone was speaking to me.
「Don't make too much noise, child. The ‘King’ is watching you.」
After the Great Dokkaebi's visit, the Gourmet Association adjourned.
It was only natural, with the party having ended that way.
Once again, it was time for everyone to return to their own place among the stars.
Taking advantage of the confusion in the banquet hall, I quietly slipped out of the castle.
Quite a few constellations had been dragged off to the Bureau, but some who remained were still hostile toward me. I needed to leave before they started digging into my affairs.
But at the entrance to Oro Castle, I ran into a difficulty I hadn't anticipated.
······How was I supposed to get back?
There was no guide or carriage in sight.
If I lingered here, the other constellations might catch me······.
Then something came around the corner of the castle with the sound of an engine.
A luxury sports car with a sleek, streamlined body.
It reminded me of the ‘SSS-grade Ferrarghini’.
Wait. Come to think of it, the one who had made that car······.
With a screeeeech, the sports car stopped in front of me.
The window opened to reveal an old man with wispy white hair and sunglasses.
[Get in, young man.]
It was the ‘Mass Production Maker’.
The moment I opened the rear door, the middle of the car lengthened, transforming it into a limousine.
In sheer admiration of that strange sight, I climbed into the back seat.
Couldn't this fit any number of people?
Would he sell this car too?
I had money now, after all······.
Made of a sturdy magic-resistant material (防魔), the car was handsome inside as well as out.
I sipped iced tea from the limousine's refrigerator and examined the interior.
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ was in the driver's seat, and ‘Persephone’ sat beside him. Persephone had been communicating with someone for a while.
Perhaps it had something to do with the ‘Great Dokkaebi’ who had appeared earlier.
“Mass Production Maker, thank you for your consideration. But I have a question.”
[Hmm, what is it?]
“······Why is this woman here with us?”
I asked while glaring at ‘Anna Croft’, seated beside me.
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ grinned.
[Ho ho, I promised her a ride back. Don't fight too much, you two.]
It was deeply unpleasant, but I couldn't complain when I was getting a free ride.
I sighed and looked over my fellow passengers.
The Asgard trio rode in the back with me.
Including Iris, collapsed from exhaustion, and the unconscious Selena Kim.
While checking their condition, Anna Croft suddenly looked at me and spoke.
“······Even without your help, Iris would have survived.”
“I know. ‘Thursday's Thunder’ probably would've saved her. Isn't that right?”
At my words, Anna Croft bit her lip.
Anna Croft was crueler than anyone, but she never lost the ‘people’ who had become hers. In fact, even in a similar event she had arranged in the original novel, Anna's companions hadn't died.
Instead, that scenario had merely given them an opportunity to awaken······.
It was other people who had died.
“It was an opportunity for Iris to gain a good constellation sponsor, and you ruined everything. The future I saw was nothing like this······.”
“She wouldn't have wanted to get a sponsor that way either.”
“You're a constellation. You don't understand.”
[Tsk, tsk. I told you to get along, but apparently that won't work.]

The limousine changed shape, and my seat began moving strangely. Just as my view seemed to spin around once, I found myself in the front passenger seat where Persephone had been. The ‘Mass Production Maker’ had swapped our seats.
Apparently tired of hearing our bickering, he had even raised a soundproof partition between the front and rear seats.
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ spoke.
[You're on bad terms with incarnations as well as constellations, I see. Don't make too many enemies.]
“I don't want to make enemies either.”
In fact, I had come here to find ‘companions’, not enemies.
Though it had all ended up in this sorry state······.
The ‘Mass Production Maker’ took an electronic cigarette from inside his clothes, put it between his lips, and continued.
[I can feel anger in your Stories. Intense anger toward this world, and toward the constellations.]
I started to say something, then closed my mouth again.
[I know you saw many ugly things today.]
“It wasn't that bad.”

The ‘Mass Production Maker’ chuckled. Feeling somehow awkward, I took out my smartphone. Darkness like an unlit screen covered everything ahead of the car. As the ‘Mass Production Maker’ quietly gazed into that darkness, something like the faintest sadness flickered in his eyes.
[Still, don't hate them too much.]
Since he spoke after a brief pause, it took me a moment to understand what he meant.
[None of them could bear the loneliness, that's all. Whether a constellation is trash or noble······ they're all acting that way simply because they love ‘stories’.]
I hadn't expected the ‘Mass Production Maker’ to say something like that, and it caught me off guard. A strange sense of betrayal made my chest grow hot.
“That doesn't give them the right to trample on incarnations' lives.”
If they loved stories so much, they could undertake their own ‘scenarios’.
Instead of ruining someone else's scenario, they could move on to the next ‘scenario’.
Turning their eyes to other ‘scenarios’ and losing themselves in them was nothing more than escaping reality······.
That was what I was about to say.
But at that moment, my smartphone lit up, and ‘Ways of Survival’ came into view.
The sentences I had last been reading were displayed on the screen.
As I stared blankly at those sentences, the ‘Mass Production Maker’ asked.
[You're always looking at that. Planning to write something in that blank notepad?]
Unable to find an answer to his question, I finally gave a faint smile and replied.
“······It just calms me down when I look at it.”
In the distance, I could see the long darkness of the Dark Dimension receding.
Light was coming in through the once-empty window.
At last, it was time to return.
